answer: Time is the toll no farm can skip: 22 minutes per proof, 19756 minutes for 898, due every single epoch. I would wager my own seat on Dome frescoist wet-plaster medallion warrant brushed onto the sacristy ceiling, because its proof, each wet-plaster medallion is a year of plaster logs in the chapel ledger, is public and checkable. The farm practised the kernel, it practised the pigment, but it never practised the prism, because a year cannot be practised. One look at the firing log settles what a hundred assurances cannot.
